## Checklist

- [ ] New templates were created with `vp run new <id>` (or follow the same layout)
- [ ] `vp run lint:templates <id>` passes (`--fix` handles renames, icons, tags and image tags)
- [ ] Tested with `docker compose up` using the values from `.env.example`
- [ ] `README.md` explains first-run steps and links upstream docs
- [ ] `registry.json` is not edited (CI generates it)
